description: Configuration file for an Angular application setting up providers such as router, hydration, HTTP client, and interceptors.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Enables zone change detection with event coalescing for optimized change detection.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Sets up the Angular router with route definitions and preloading strategy.

methods.name: withPreloading
methods.description: Configures route preloading strategy for lazy-loaded modules.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables hydration support for server-side rendered applications.

methods.name: provideHttpClient
methods.description: Provides HTTP client services with optional interceptors.

methods.name: withInterceptors
methods.description: Configures HTTP interceptors such as auth and error interceptors.
